basic_details.job_title: MGU Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for Research Assistant and Field Investigator Posts
basic_details.short_information: Mahatma Gandhi University (MGU) has published the Research Assistant and Field Investigator Notification 2026. The recruitment drive aims to fill 3 Research Assistant and Field Investigator positions on a contractual basis. Candidates holding a Post Graduate degree in Social Sciences/Humanities (minimum 55% marks), with NET/ M.Phil./ Ph.D. as applicable for the Research Assistant post, are eligible to apply via Email. Applications must be submitted on or before 10 August 2026, and candidates can easily access the official notification PDF and application details below.

salary_details.details: Research Assistant: Rs. 37,000/- p.m. Field Investigator: Rs. 20,000/- p.m.

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for MGU Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 10-08-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the MGU Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Research Assistant: Post Graduate in Social Sciences/Humanities (55% minimum) with NET/M.Phil./Ph.D. Desirable: Expertise in studies on kinship and rituals. Field Investigator: Post Graduate in Social Sciences/Humanities with a minimum 55% marks. Desirable: Familiarity with Studies on kinship and rituals.

content_sections.heading: Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Research Assistant: Rs. 37,000/- p.m. Field Investigator: Rs. 20,000/- p.m.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for MGU Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 10-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for MGU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the MGU Research Assistant and Field Investigator posts is 10 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Research Assistant and Field Investigator posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies announced by Mahatma Gandhi University for the positions of Research Assistant and Field Investigator.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum educational qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a Post Graduate degree in Social Sciences/Humanities with a minimum of 55% marks. For the Research Assistant role, NET/M.Phil./Ph.D. is also required.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 20,000/- per month for Field Investigators to Rs. 37,000/- per month for Research Assistants.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for MGU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for MGU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process typically involves shortlisting of eligible candidates followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q7. How should candidates apply for the MGU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Interested candidates need to apply via email by sending their complete bio-data and self-attested copies of required documents to the official email address before the deadline.

faq.question: Q8. Where is Mahatma Gandhi University located?
faq.answer: Mahatma Gandhi University is located in Kottayam, Kerala, with the pincode 686041.

faq.question: Q9. Are there any age relaxations mentioned in the notification?
faq.answer: The provided data does not specify any age limits or age relaxations. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for details.

faq.question: Q10. What are the desirable qualifications for the posts?
faq.answer: For Research Assistant, expertise in studies on kinship and rituals is desirable. For Field Investigator, familiarity with studies on kinship and rituals is desirable.
